caption: The drawing depicts a single, cylindrical wooden container with a textured, weathered surface in varying shades of brown, suggesting it is made from thick, rough-hewn wood. The lid, also wooden and brown, is rounded and sits unevenly on top of the container, with a large, upward-curving handle attached. A leather-like strap, in a lighter brown color, is fastened to the lid and curves over the handle, draping loosely. The container and its lid both show clear wood grain and cracks, adding to the realistic rendering of their material. The object is centered on a plain, off-white background with no other elements present, and there is a small handwritten inscription in the bottom right corner.
title: Bucket
